data.title: Comparing Lengths
data.description: Listen to the pairs of things and say out loud which word describes them.
data.gradeLevel: elementary students (grades 1-5) - Use age-appropriate vocabulary, concrete examples, structured learning objectives, and interactive elements. Build fundamental understanding.

items.ask: Here is a train, and here is a bicycle. Is the bicycle longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying just the word or a phrase ending in the word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying the name of the object instead of the comparison word is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The bicycle takes up less space end to end, so it is shorter.

actionContract.label: Which Word?
actionContract.instruction: Here is a train, and here is a bicycle. Is the bicycle longer or shorter?

items.ask: Here is a snake, and here is an earthworm. Is the snake longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying just the word or a phrase ending in rall or length counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying the wrong comparison word like shorter is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The snake stretches out further from end to end, so it is longer.

actionContract.label: Which Word?
actionContract.instruction: Here is a snake, and here is an earthworm. Is the snake longer or shorter?

items.ask: Here is a crayon, and here is a giant slide. Is the crayon longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying just the word or a phrase ending in the word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying the opposite word like longer is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The crayon has less distance from tip to end than the slide, so it is shorter.

actionContract.label: Which Word?

items.ask: Here is a school bus, and here is a skateboard. Is the school bus longer or shorter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying just the word or a phrase ending in the word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying the wrong menu choice is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The school bus extends over a greater distance than the skateboard, so it is longer.
